respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture represents a Next-Gen Security Operations Center (SOC) telemetry and incident response platform. Visual box b0 ('AWS') is a generic cloud group that is expanded per Rule 5 into the specific services named in the narration (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, S3 source, SNS, SQS). Visual box b1 ('ON-PREM') maps to OnPremDC. Apache Metron (b2), SOAR/Blitz (b6), and Alerts (b7) map to ThirdParty components. The Security Data Lake container contains EMR (b3), S3 (b4), and Athena (b5), with a documented feedback loop from S3 back to Metron. Automated remediation connects Alerts to AWS WAF (b8).
respuesta.nombre: Next-Gen SOC Architecture with Apache Metron and AWS Security Data Lake
